title.narrative: Support concrete transformative solutions for the adoption and effective implementation of an ambitious GBF

description.narrative: Transformative solutions will be understood as solutions that have the potential of sparking transformation of biodiversity governance, as understood according to the final Post2020 Global Biodiversity Framework, the various IPBES assessments and other scientific data defining the characteristics of transformative change.The impact of the project and grantee will be measured through the contributions it may have to the abovementioned solutions being developed among its partners (including partner countries, civil society, the private sector, subnational and local governments, etc.).

title.narrative: Number of commitments being implemented that have a positive impact on biodiversity

description.narrative: Commitments being implemented will be understood as political decisions announced and/or registered on a dedicated platform by a decisionmaking partner (in particular, countries and subnational and local governments) that are operationalized at policy level (local laws, guidelines, strategies), monitored and reported with a positive short to medium term impact on biodiversity, in line with the projects 7 priority topics and the Post2020 Global Biodiversity Framework
